## Summary

Adds the August 2026 monthly report for ARWG.

The report is concise due to summer PTO period and focuses on:
- D2 survey review cycle in PR #9
- D1 review status in PR #8
- cross-WG coordination and phase 2 preparation
- explicit consolidated answers to review questions raised on July report PR #7
